last_resurrection.title: Exclude files or directories from editor.formatOnSave
last_resurrection.one_line_why: The addition of native glob pattern support in VSCode settings since 2024 enables selective formatOnSave exclusions.
last_resurrection.one_line_summary: VSCode should allow users to exclude specific files or directories from the editor.formatOnSave operation.
